snippet.title: Monstabox | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Monstabox: A turn-based 1v1 battle game mixing strategy & action. Choose monsters, cast spells, roll to attack, and unleash ultimates. Win by securing the Star after KOing your opponent. Play cross-platform & compete worldwide!
